title.signIn: This sign-in could not be completed
title.request: This request could not be completed
background: WS-Federation defines no error response for a sign-in request: the request is a browser navigation, so there is nothing to send an error back to, and this page is the answer. Nothing has been sent to the relying party.
refusal.general: This WS-Federation request could not be completed.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0001: This request names a wreqptr: an address this service would have to fetch the sign-in request from. It does not fetch addresses handed to it, so the application must send the request itself, in wreq.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0002: This request does not name the relying party it is for (wtrealm), and every sign-in must name one.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0003: The reply address (wreply) for relying party {realm} is not one registered for it, so this service will not send a token there.
refusal.STS-REG-0049: The reply address for relying party {realm} was learned from an earlier request and nobody has confirmed it, so this service will not send a token there yet.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0004: The reply address (wreply) for this sign-in is not an absolute http or https address, so the token cannot be sent to it.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0005: The application asked for a kind of token this service does not issue. It issues SAML 1.1 and SAML 2.0 assertions.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0006: The application asked for a way of signing in (wauth) that this service does not offer.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0007: The sign-in was cancelled or did not succeed, so nothing has been sent to the application.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0008: The wfresh value in this request is not a number of minutes.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0009: The application asked for a sign-in with a security key, and none was used.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0010: The application asked for a sign-in with a second factor, and only one factor was used.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0030: The application asked for a phishing-resistant sign-in with a passkey, and the sign-in did not use one.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0011: You are signed in, but this service's policy does not allow relying party {realm} to receive a token for you.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0018: Relying party {realm} does not allow the way you signed in.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0023: Relying party {realm} does not allow the second factor you used.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0029: This sign-in was refused because it was assessed as risky, even after you signed in again.
refusal.STS-CORE-0121: This realm is being removed, so no sign-in to it can be completed.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0012: This service does not offer the {wa} service.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0013: This service does not understand the request wa={wa}.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0021: Relying party {realm} is not registered with this service.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0024: Relying party {realm} is not registered with this service.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0025: A sign-in to relying party {realm} cannot be started from this service: that is turned off for it.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0026: This sign-in link names a reply address (wreply), and a sign-in started here goes only to the address registered for the relying party. Remove wreply from the link.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0027: No usable reply address is registered for relying party {realm}, so there is nowhere to send the token.
refusal.STS-WSFED-0028: Relying party {realm} may not start a sign-in here: that is turned off for it.
accepts.heading: What it accepts
accepts.note: It refuses rather than answering with a password sign-in on purpose: wauth is how a relying party demands a method, and ignoring it would make the demand appear to have been met.
forward.heading: Two ways forward
forward.retryKey: Start the sign-in again and use your security key, on its own or after your password. The assertion then says {multi} (with a password) or {hardware} (on its own). If you have no key yet, you can add one in your account.
forward.retrySecond: Start the sign-in again and complete the second step, with a security key or a one-time code. The assertion then says {multi}. If you have neither yet, you can add one in your account.
forward.retryPasskey: Start the sign-in again and use a passkey. If you have none yet, you can add one in your account.
forward.retryHardwarePasskey: Start the sign-in again and use a passkey kept on a security key or other hardware. If you have none yet, you can add one in your account.
forward.without: Or ask for what this session already has:
policy.note: The roles a relying party requires are on its application entry, and an administrator can see who holds them.
understands.heading: What this endpoint understands
understands.signIn: wsignin1.0: sign in, and have a token posted to wreply
understands.signOut: wsignout1.0: sign out, and send a cleanup request to each relying party
understands.cleanup: wsignoutcleanup1.0: end the session without sending anything on
